summary.headline: Horary Judgment of Substance
summary.text: Astrological rules for whether a sought matter involving substance is accomplished, emphasizing reception, the strength and angularity of the dispositor, and the effects of angular, succedent, and cadent houses. Conjunctions among the ascendant lord, Moon, second-house lord, fortunes, and malefics determine success, delay, destruction, petition, and unexpected gain.
